name: Browser Picker
description: Choose the browser and profile for every link, with per-site rules that learn from what you pick: a picker card per link (haseen setup default browser browser-picker makes it the default browser), a bar button and a panel with the rules. Every installed browser is found from its desktop entry, Flatpaks included. Adopted from t1nk33r.browser-picker (K53N0/omarchy-browser-picker, MIT); off by default

autoOpenRules.description: Open a link that matches a rule without asking; off keeps rules as ranking hints

learnRules.description: Offer to make a repeated choice a rule (Ctrl+Enter accepts)

promptAfter.description: Times the same site must go to the same profile before the offer (2-20)

genericFirst.description: List browsers without separate profiles first while nothing is typed

debugIpc.description: Test hook: expose IPC targets haseen.browser-picker.debug (state, filter, choose, cancel) and haseen.browser-picker.panel
